all existing-workflow actions require known workflow for same caller; report also requires known runId
review transitions draft/revise to approved/revise/blocked; stop on unchanged-suite loop or budget exhaustion
run/retest require approved unchanged suite and no unknownWrites; retest requires priorRunId from same workflow
request only accepts path/query/body; path is parameter object; method and URL derive from operation
each executable case needs at least one JSON assertion; negative status needs confirmed input-status rule
